subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive with FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Malik <samir@finpath.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps + proposed demo times

Hi Samir — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary use case: real-time document ingestion + retrieval-augmented generation for customer support workflows.
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p95 response for short queries, predictable per-token cost, and SOC2-aligned controls for auditability.
- Key stakeholders: Platform team (Liam) for infra/security, Procurement (Priya) for contracting.

Next steps I suggested on the call were: 1) technical deep dive / demo with our solutions engineer, and 2) joint mutual action plan so procurement and security have what they need.

Proposed windows for a 60-min technical deep dive next week (all PST):
- Tue 11/10 10:00–11:00
- Wed 11/11 14:00–15:00
- Thu 11/12 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, share a couple times that do and I’ll coordinate. I’m looping in Dylan (SE) to run the demo and Monica from our security team to surface SOC2 / data handling items.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (application/pdf) — draft agenda + checklist

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
\

From: Samir Malik <samir@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps + proposed demo times

Hi Marissa — appreciate the recap. Wed 11/11 14:00 PST works best for us for the demo.

Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Can you include a brief SOC2 summary and any notes on data residency/retention? Our security team (cc'd Liam) will want that before the deep dive.
2) Procurement will need a simple mutual action plan / timeline; Priya Shah is the right contact and I’ll loop her once we have a proposed slot.

If Dylan can do the demo on Wed 11/11 at 14:00 PST, please confirm and send a calendar invite. Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

—Samir
Samir Malik | Head of Platform Engineering, FinPath
samir@finpath.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Malik <samir@finpath.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps + proposed demo times

Thanks Samir — looping Priya in for procurement and confirming Dylan + Monica on our side.

Dylan — can you take Wed 11/11 14:00–15:00 PST for the demo/technical deep dive? We’ll plan for ~40 mins demo + 20 mins Q&A. Suggested focal points: model latency and batching behavior, KV/prefix caching, and integration touchpoints for your ingestion pipeline.

Monica — could you attach the SOC2 summary and a short note on data retention controls? Samir asked for that ahead of the session.

Priya — if you want to propose contract timing or an initial procurement checklist, feel free to add it to the mutual_action_plan.pdf (attached).

I’ll send the calendar invite once we have confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 09:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps + proposed demo times

Hi all — shared a short SOC2 summary and the data handling notes below. Attaching SOC2 summary doc for Priya/Samir.

- SOC2: We maintain Type II controls for the past 12 months; scope covers logical access, encryption at rest/in transit, and change management. See attached.
- Data residency: Hosted in us-west-2 by default; private deployment option available for dedicated VPCs.
- Retention: Default logs retained 90 days; customer-configurable retention for audit logs.

Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf (application/pdf)

Happy to review specifics on the call.
—Monica Patel
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
